Customize shop: name, logo, banner, contact details
Publish for your team

Staff get a billing-only page with your items, prices, shop name, tax rate, banner, payment methods and order settings. They can only bill: pick items, choose the payment method, print the customer copy and save the invoice. They cannot change anything else. Set everything up on this page, then download the staff page and put it online. Keep this admin page private: do not upload or share it.

Upload the downloaded file to your GitHub Pages repository as index.html, replacing the old one, and share that link with staff. Download and upload again whenever you change items or prices.

Pictures, names and prices below are examples. Use Edit on a card to change its name or price, Photo to replace its picture, or add new items below.
